faces.name: Rocco, Street Chef
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your end step, each player exiles the top card of their library. Until your next end step, each player may play the card they exiled this way.
Whenever a player plays a land from exile or casts a spell from exile, you put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")

faces.name: Rocco, Snack Supplier
faces.oracleText:
When Rocco enters, create two Food tokens. (They're artifacts with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.")
Whenever you sacrifice a Food, each opponent gains 3 life.
{4}, {T}: Search your library for a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of times players have gained life this turn, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
